text:
ben-sales: Quick kickoff — Kepler Health POC benchmark. They want to validate latency/throughput and see pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted. Target: sustained 200 qps, microbursts to 1k qps. Any immediate blockers?

lia-se: Got it. Drafting a 3-phase runbook: smoke (5m), steady-state 200 qps (3h), burst stress 1k qps (10x 1min bursts). Need guidance on model choice — they want chat + embeddings. Suggest rwd-open-1.7b-quant as cost baseline, and rwd-open-8b+ for quality check.

omar-devops: Ops notes: we'll need explicit prewarm + KV cache priming to avoid tail spikes. Also need whether customer requires KMS/HSM for key management (HIPAA). What's p95 goal for chat?

ben-sales: Customer asks p95 chat <150ms (prompt-limited), embeddings p95 <50ms. They flagged HIPAA — security questionnaire inbound from their legal team.

eva-eng: For chat p95=150ms we should run on Dedicated with pinned GPUs; keep batching small (batch_size<=4) or continuous batching disabled for latency-sensitive routes. Will add autoscale and warmup hooks to runbook. Also recommend a 5-min warmup of representative prompts to populate KV cache.

zoe-ml: I'll assemble a 50-case prompt set for regen/quality + embed mixes (short/long contexts). For stress tests, include fallback policy to smaller model so we don't hit 504s under burst.

omar-devops: Scheduling — propose run tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need cluster spec input: prefer 4xA100-40 baseline (cost-friendly) and we can simulate H100 in calc. Please confirm. Loadgen details below.

omar-devops: ```bash
# load generator (wrk + lua chat pattern)
wrk -t12 -c200 -d00:30 -s scripts/chat_workload.lua --latency http://redwood-poc-host:8080
# steady-state: scale connections to emulate token rate, then run burst test with -c1000 for 1m
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary to staging at 2024-06-12T08:45Z — build: 2024.06.12-rc4. Will post status when canary passes.

eva-eng: Pricing ask for sales deck: produce two lines — reserved Dedicated cluster cost (monthly) + overage per 1M tokens for burst. Lia, can you do rough math after we pick cluster variant? I can add efficiency gains from quantization and batching policies.

lia-se: Preliminary numbers: 4xA100 reserved cluster ~ $28k/mo, projected capacity ~ 200 qps for rwd-open-1.7b-quant with headroom for bursts using autoscale. Rough token cost ~ $0.45/1M tokens (quantized baseline) — will tighten after run.

ben-sales: Action items: lia produce cost sheet and put dollar ranges, zoe deliver prompt+eval set, omar run bench + paste raw wrk logs, eva write fallback & SLA note, I'll prepare security questionnaire template to send to Kepler legal.

omar-devops: Copy of run checklist I'll paste once staging canary passes. Expect raw logs and simple latency histogram CSV. If anyone needs specific metrics (p50/p95/p99, tail percentiles, token/sec) call them out now.

zoe-ml: Request: include quality gate — BLEU/ROUGE-ish similarity for regen and embed nearest-neighbor hit rate for embeddings. I will annotate prompts with acceptance thresholds.

ben-sales: Sweet. I'll sync with Kepler PM after we have run artifacts and cost sheet. Thanks team :thumbsup:
